messages:
Anya R: Quick heads-up — canary for the new token-governor hit p95 regressions on route chat-infer-2 after the kernel-affinity change.
Sam B: saw it on dashboards too, p95 jumped from 210ms -> 480ms, tails look bad :grimacing:
Anya R: canary % is 10%. Trace: https://go/trace/ci/1749999999 (internal)
Maria L: query I ran: `sum(rate(latency_p95{route=\"chat-infer-2\"}[5m]))`
Hao K: profiling quick dump shows increased microbatch wait in queue but also a kernel switch happening per-request.
Hao K: snippet from perf: ```batch_wait_ms: 120 -> 360\nkernel_switches: 0.9 -> 2.7 per request\nkv_cache_hit: 0.82 -> 0.61\``` 
Sam B: hmm KV hit drop could explain more prefix recompute + bigger KV loads
Anya R: was hoping token budget regulator was conservative enough. Config pushed: `route.token_budget_target=150` -> 220 for canary
Leo T: that increases batch sizes, but with kernel-swaps it hurts due to extra memcpy/warmups
Maria L: recommended immediate mitigation: throttle token_budget_target back to 150 for canary and enable `batcher.fastpath=true` for chat-infer-2
Sam B: agree. Also can we pin kernel for that route to the cheaper attention kernel? use `kernel_hint=attn_fused_v2`
Hao K: Kernel pin works but we need to ensure latency SLO across seq len distribution. I'll run microbenchmarks: `./bench --route chat-infer-2 --kernels fused_v1,fused_v2 --seq 64,256` and paste results
DevBot: deploy job #49872 started by Anya R -> rollback-config canary 10% (token_budget_target revert)
OpsBot: alert #INC-18721 triggered: p95(latency) chat-infer-2 > 450ms for 10m
Anya R: action items:
• Hao: run kernel microbench and KV warmup perf (results in 1h)
• Sam: revert token_budget_target on canary and toggle fastpath (now)
• Maria: verify KV cache prefill heuristics + adjust warmup windows
• Leo: prepare rollback if metrics not recover in 20m
Sam B: I'll roll back now and post status
Anya R: thanks. If rollback doesn't fix, plan B is to reduce canary to 1% and do canary-by-length buckets.
Leo T: noted. I'll standby for rollback verification.
Sam B: rollback applied, canary now 1% — monitoring...
Maria L: KV hit recovered to 0.79 after rollback, p95 drifting down to 230ms
Hao K: microbench results uploaded: https://go/artifacts/bench/1749999999 — fused_v2 shows 2.4x warmup cost on cold KV, need to avoid kernel switches during microbatches
Anya R: good catch. Next steps: update planner to prefer kernel affinity stable within a batch and add a KV-prefetch window when token_budget increases. Will write RFC.
Leo T: assigning follow-ups in Asana. Closing thread once RFC linked.
Sam B: :thumbsup:
DevBot: job #49872 completed: rollback success
Anya R: closing — thanks everyone.
